title: 访问所有节点的最短路径
summary: 连通无向图可从任意节点出发、重复经过节点，求访问所有节点的最短路径长度。
insight: 状态由当前位置和已访问节点位掩码组成；把每个节点作为零步起点同时入队，多源 BFS 首次得到全掩码就是全局最短。
pitfalls: 起点可任意选择，所以全部单节点状态都是 BFS 源
visited 要区分相同节点下不同掩码

solutions.title: 多源状态压缩 BFS
solutions.idea: 在节点乘访问集合的状态图上求最短路。
steps: targetMask=(1<<n)-1；为每个 node 入队 (node,1<<node,0) 并标记
弹出状态，mask==target 返回 distance
对每个邻居生成 nextMask=mask|1<<neighbor，未访问状态入队 distance+1

code.java: class Solution { public int shortestPathLength(int[][] graph){int n=graph.length,target=(1<<n)-1;boolean[][] seen=new boolean[n][1<<n];Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int node=0;node<n;node++){queue.offer(new int[]{node,1<<node,0});seen[node][1<<node]=true;}while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] state=queue.poll();if(state[1]==target)return state[2];for(int next:graph[state[0]]){int mask=state[1]|1<<next;if(!seen[next][mask]){seen[next][mask]=true;queue.offer(new int[]{next,mask,state[2]+1});}}}return -1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun shortestPathLength(graph:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=graph.size;val target=(1 shl n)-1;val seen=Array(n){BooleanArray(1 shl n)};val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();for(node in 0 until n){queue.addLast(intArrayOf(node,1 shl node,0));seen[node][1 shl node]=true};while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.removeFirst();if(state[1]==target)return state[2];for(next in graph[state[0]]){val mask=state[1] or (1 shl next);if(!seen[next][mask]){seen[next][mask]=true;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(next,mask,state[2]+1))}}};return -1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int shortestPathLength(vector<vector<int>>& graph){int n=graph.size(),target=(1<<n)-1;vector<vector<bool>> seen(n,vector<bool>(1<<n));queue<array<int,3>> pending;for(int node=0;node<n;++node){pending.push({node,1<<node,0});seen[node][1<<node]=true;}while(!pending.empty()){auto [node,mask,distance]=pending.front();pending.pop();if(mask==target)return distance;for(int next:graph[node]){int nextMask=mask|1<<next;if(!seen[next][nextMask]){seen[next][nextMask]=true;pending.push({next,nextMask,distance+1});}}}return -1;} };
